artifact-analysis.next: route to the matching forensics reference for the identified type

encoding-constraint.probe: normalize/decode exactly one layer and record the alphabet diff
encoding-constraint.expected: each decode step changes the alphabet in a measurable way
encoding-constraint.falsifier: the carrier is not a plain encoding (encrypted or keyed)
encoding-constraint.next: name the final constraint and solve it with the cheapest solver

idor.probe: request the same object id as a second identity and diff the responses
idor.expected: the second identity reads or mutates the object
idor.falsifier: ownership is enforced on the server side, not just hidden client-side
idor.next: enumerate the id space only after the differential confirms

parameter-weakness.probe: collect every parameter (key size, exponent, nonce, mode) and check the known-weak list
parameter-weakness.expected: one parameter matches a named weakness pattern
parameter-weakness.falsifier: all parameters are strong; the attack is in usage, not parameters
parameter-weakness.next: run the deterministic attack for the matched weakness

validation-path.probe: strings and symbols first; find the compare that decides correct/wrong
validation-path.expected: one deciding check with its input and expected value visible
validation-path.falsifier: the check is computed, not compared (hash, transform, VM)
validation-path.next: replicate the check outside the binary before patching it
